title: Dr. Silvia Colombo 
--- 

Silvia Colombo was Project Officer at the initial stages of the Ecosystem Indicators Workflows (EIW) project initiative led by UNSW Sydney. Silvia completed a Ph.D. at the University of Melbourne on the evolution of the architecture of avian nests. She is currently working at Macquarie University as a Research Assistant, helping to digitalize The Downing Herbarium collection to make specimens available to the public. Her background includes taxonomy, animal behaviour and navigation.
